description: Ticket W1B-1. Implement the WorktreeManager contract in src/main/worktree-manager.ts with real git commands: create, autoCommit, diffSummary, merge, discard, and openInEditor.
steps: Read the contracts in this ticket, then global-sct/src/main/share-gate.ts (code style) and global-sct/tests/envelope.test.ts (test style).

Create src/main/worktree-manager.ts. Export createWorktreeManager (signature in context.key_patterns). Run git with execFile('git', [...args], { cwd }) and no shell. Import the types from '../shared/contracts'.

create: for mode 'isolated' run `git worktree add -b agent/<jobId> <worktreesRoot>/<jobId> <baseBranch>` in repoRoot and return { repoRoot, worktreePath, branch: 'agent/<jobId>', baseBranch, isIsolatedWorktree: true }. For mode 'in-place' create nothing and return { repoRoot, worktreePath: repoRoot, branch: <the current branch of repoRoot>, baseBranch, isIsolatedWorktree: false }. Reject a jobId that is not /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$/ before any git command.

autoCommit: `git add -A`, then commit with the message when `git status --porcelain` is not empty, and return { commitHash: <full hash> }. Return { commitHash: null } when nothing changed. Pass `-c user.name=Lemon Tree -c user.email=lemon-tree@localhost` only when the repository has no user.name.

diffSummary: compare baseBranch with the worktree branch head using `git diff --numstat -z` and `git diff --name-status -z` between `<baseBranch>...<branch>` (three dots). A binary file has additions 0, deletions 0, binary true. status is modified, added, deleted, or renamed. Set commitHash to the branch head. totalAdditions and totalDeletions are the sums.

merge: only for an isolated worktree. In repoRoot, when the current branch is baseBranch and the tree is clean, run `git merge --no-ff --no-edit <branch>`. On success return { merged: true, mergeCommit }. On a conflict collect the conflicted paths (`git diff --name-only --diff-filter=U`), run `git merge --abort`, and return { merged: false, conflicts, reason }. When repoRoot is on another branch or is not clean, return { merged: false, conflicts: [], reason } and change nothing.

discard: for an isolated worktree run `git worktree remove --force <worktreePath>` and `git branch -D <branch>` in repoRoot. For an in-place worktree do nothing. openInEditor: call launchEditor(editor, [worktreePath]) where editor is 'code', 'cursor', or 'zed'.
Create tests/worktree-manager.test.ts. Each test makes a real temporary git repository with mkdtemp (git init -b main, user.name and user.email set, one commit) and removes it after. No mock of git.
Run `bun run typecheck:tsc` and `bun run lint` from global-sct/ and correct each error. Commit the two files with one commit.
acceptance_criteria: src/main/worktree-manager.ts exports createWorktreeManager, and its result satisfies the WorktreeManager interface without a type cast
Each git call uses an argument array and no shell
No file outside the worktrees root and the given repository is written
An invalid jobId is rejected before git runs
merge never leaves repoRoot in a merge state
bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run lint, and bun run test pass

must_add: create with mode isolated makes the worktree directory on branch agent/<jobId> from the base branch and returns the metadata
create with mode in-place makes no worktree and returns the repository root and its current branch
create rejects a jobId with a path separator or '..' and makes no directory
autoCommit commits a new file and a changed file and returns the commit hash; a second call with no change returns null
diffSummary reports one added, one modified, and one deleted file with correct line counts and totals, and a binary file with binary true
merge of a clean change gives merged true and the base branch contains the file
merge with a conflict gives merged false with the conflicted path, and the repository has no merge in progress after it
merge is refused when the repository root is on another branch
discard removes the worktree directory and the agent branch
openInEditor calls the launcher with the editor command and the worktree path

findings: Ready for dispatch through a T3 subagent (decision S4).
